name: Arjun
label: Tidal-leaning seeker of lossless audio
who: I listen for the music itself and care about sound quality, so I have used Tidal or Qobuz for lossless listening. I keep Spotify for discovery and Spotify Connect, and I have paid for two services at once.
value_for_money: Several note that Tidal and other services offer lossless at similar or lower cost, and some keep a second service just for hi-fi. Others say Spotify is cheap for their listening volume and that its convenience is worth it.
loyalty: Spotify Connect, its discovery and recommendation features, and device support keep them on Spotify. The lack of lossless audio pushed some to Tidal or Qobuz, and Spotify's UI changes drove others away.
pain_points: No lossless or HiFi tier on Spotify
UI redesign making the app harder to use
Tidal has buggy apps and missing artists
Spotify focus on podcasts and social features
likes: Discovery and recommendations such as Discover Weekly and Release Radar
Lossless audio on Tidal or Qobuz
reasons_to_stay: They keep Spotify for Connect, playback across speakers and devices, and recommendations such as Discover Weekly and Release Radar, which one user calls a strong discovery tool. They use Tidal or Qobuz for listening that needs lossless audio, so Spotify stays their everyday app.
tone: Blunt and opinionated, pointing out Spotify's gaps with a frustrated or sarcastic edge while still listing what works.
